title: GSTR-2B vs Books Reconciliation: Securing 100% Legitimate Input Tax Credit
summary: Procedural steps for resolving GSTR 2B 3B ITC mismatches under Rule 36(4) and defending against DRC-01A and Section 73 discrepancy notices.
body:
Claiming Input Tax Credit (ITC) without strict reconciliation against GSTR-2B invites automatic DRC-01A intimations and DRC-01B notices. Under Section 16(2)(aa) of the CGST Act, 2017, no assessee can avail credit unless the invoice is furnished by the supplier in their GSTR-1.

Mandatory Compliance Protocols:
• Monthly invoice-level automated matching against GSTR-2B JSON dumps.
• Tracking non-compliant suppliers failing to remit tax under Section 16(2)(c).
• Timely issuance of debit/credit notes prior to the annual deadline.

Maintain rigorous vendor verification records to prevent ITC reversals with penal interest under Section 50. Learn more about our [GST Retainer Services](/services) or connect with our [Serampore & Rishra Tax Desk](/locations/serampore-rishra).
